verdicts.title: utils.py module docstring enumerates only 3 of the helper concerns; omits declared-return validation
verdicts.reasoning: Read utils.py lines 1-7: the docstring says 'identifier assignment for generated kernel source, formula njit-wrapping, and formula arity validation'. The file defines five functions: _assign_identifiers (covered), _wrap_formula (covered), _check_formula_arity (covered), plus _strip_cache (line 76) and _validate_declared_return (line 84) which are not mentioned. Confirmed that _validate_declared_return is live: compile_kernel.py line 61 imports it and line 863 calls it. The omission is a real doc/code drift. Severity low is appropriate — no runtime effect.
